newsitem.title: USA: Arvin closes acquisition, sees sales gain.
newsitem.headline: Arvin closes acquisition, sees sales gain.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Friday it has completed the $29 million purchase of the remaining shares owned by Sogefi S.p.A. in Timax Exhaust Systems (Holding) BV (TESH).

On an annualized basis, those TESH operations which were not previously consolidated will add about $100 million to Arvin's sales and make positive earnings contributions this year, Arvin said in a statement.

TESH was formed in 1993 as a joint venture company owned equally by Arvin and Sogefi to service the European replacement exhaust market. TESH is comprised of Timax Exhaust Systems based in the United Kingdom, Rosi S.A. in France, and Ansa Marmitte S.p.A. in Italy.
TESH has five manufacturing locations and distribution networks in the U.K., France and Italy.
Arvin said it will seek to develop sales and distribution in all European markets, including the rapidly developing markets in Eastern Europe.
Arvin makes automotive components and has more than 50 manufacturing facilities and eight technical centers located in 16 countries.
